rules.statement: In a test project, add a direct ProjectReference to every test support project whose types the tests use, rather than reaching it transitively through another support project.
rules.why: If the intermediate support project stops referencing it, the test project stops compiling. The rule to reference a project directly from the project that uses its types applies to test support projects too.
rules.check: Look at test code that uses a type from a test support project. Check that the test .csproj has a ProjectReference to that support project itself, and doesn't rely on some other support project referencing it.
